notes: Singapore's styles (sg-singapore) on china-south: HDB slabs and point blocks (accent paint, corridor faces, void decks, AC ledges), multi-storey car parks, shophouses (pastel fronts, louvred shutters, the five-foot way, clay-tile roofs), granite CBD towers, colonial civic buildings (white render, a colonnade, a light cornice), condominiums (floor-to-ceiling glass, balconies, white slab edges), Sentosa's villas, a Chinese temple's red pillared walls (temple: the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, its roofs a figure) and the mosques' and Hindu temples' cream walls (worship); china-south's glass, commercial, civic, factory, plain and landmark skins kept. Their patterns are on the wall itself (no fade: they read from the air), facade/patterns.js: paintBands, corridorAccess, voidDeck, fiveFootWay, colonnade, balconySlabs, shophouseFront (the shutters: paired louvred leaves the window's height, open or closed, and the party-wall pilasters). Facade options (M4 fix round 1): factories' blue roofs fewer and grey-blue, coated silver glass (no ink-black CBD; the city lift 0.6 and floor 0.1 of 7 Oct dropped on 8 Oct: they pulled every reflection to the pale horizon haze and the CBD read as milky clay from the air), plain windows a little more reflective and the window grid faded to its mean from ~12 px a bay (no black speckle at mid distance).
